hyperparameters.rule: contrastive coupled learning (free solve -> soft cross-entropy clamp -> contrastive gate update)
hyperparameters.input: 7-token context x 16-D SciBERT-FA embedding = 112 gate inputs, applied as source voltages in [0.0,0.45] V (no analog front end)
hyperparameters.data: self-valid quantum-physics corpus (4 grammatical shapes incl. questions), windowed into 7-token contexts; held-out split for the test metrics

network.structure: input-output fully-connected NMOS network: 122 output branches x 112 gate inputs; branch drain voltages read as next-token logits via masked softmax (123 symbols = 122 tokens + masked <BOS>; temperature readout)

noise.note: per-device threshold-voltage mismatch (sigma=10 mV) and per-device drive-strength (kp) mismatch (sigma=0.5%), fixed per chip; free and clamp are electrically-separate device sets; plus a Gaussian read-noise stream on every measurement (training and inference).
